pins.name: ADDR
pins.notes: Address select: GND 0x48, VDD 0x49, SDA 0x4A, SCL 0x4B

gotchas.text: Each input must stay between GND and VDD, even in differential mode. The default range is ±2.048 V; set the gain for larger signals.
